summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its subsidiary VEON Midco B.V. priced a USD 1.4 billion bond offering of senior unsecured notes in two tranches: USD 700 million 6.95% senior notes due 2031 (non-callable for 2 years) and USD 700 million 7.45% senior notes due 2033 (non-callable for 3 years), both priced at par. Proceeds will refinance existing debt, including up to USD 750 million to purchase outstanding 3.375% senior notes due 2027 via a previously announced tender offer. The notes are expected to be rated BB- by S&P and Fitch, rank pari passu, and will be admitted to the Euro MTF market. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
